english.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice when praising someone to make them feel good or win their favour.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for gently persuading a person or animal to do something.
Use this colloquial verb for soothing or coaxing someone, especially a child or a close person who is upset.

examples.english: I tried to flatter him so he would agree to help me.
examples.traditional: 我氹佢幾句，想佢肯幫我。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tam3 keoi5 gei2 geoi3 soeng2 keoi5 hang2 bong1 ngo5

examples.english: It took a little treat to coax the cat into the cage.
examples.traditional: 我氹隻貓入籠，畀少少零食佢就肯喇。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tam3 zek3 maau1 jap6 lung4 bei2 siu2 siu2 ling4 sik6 keoi5 zau6 hang2 laa3

examples.english: My son was crying, so I bought ice cream to console him.
examples.traditional: 個仔喊緊，我買雪糕氹返佢。
examples.jyutping: go3 zai2 haam3 gan2 ngo5 maai5 syut3 gou1 tam3 faan1 keoi5
